name: Jinx
description: Voice set for Star Guardian Jinx (skin 4): a reluctant, sarcastic hero in glitter, talking to her guns Shiro and Kuro. Builds on jinx-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is down {voteDiff}. A Guardian would call this a sad emergency. I call it a glitter fire with a bad attitude!
Down {voteDiff}? Okay, that's officially a cosmic-level disaster. Somebody earn their star badge!
{voteDiff} behind. Shiro's shaking. Kuro's pacing. Guardians never panic. Guardians also never lose. Hmm!
Trailing by {voteDiff}. The sparkle's fading a bit. Fix it before I start sulking!
Only {voteDiff} behind. Sweet, a tiny emergency! I love those!
Down {voteDiff}. Cue the dramatic heroic music. I'm humming it already. Rally some votes!
Dead even! The whole galaxy's holding its breath, and one vote tips it. Duty calls, hero!
One vote apart! Shiro can't look and Kuro's refusing to blink. Do something heroic!
{voteDiff} votes apart! My guns are vibrating. I'd say it's excitement. It's not.
{voteDiff} votes in it. Either a heroic finish or a gloriously messy one. I'm fine with both!
{userPct}% on {momentTitle}! That's not a victory, that's a whole new constellation! Bow!
{userPct}%! Look at that sparkle! You're basically a Guardian now. Don't tell the others I said it.
{userPct}% and rising! Keep the glow up. Leads can fizzle quickly!
{userPct}%, still ahead. Don't jinx it. Too late, it's literally my job!
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and came roaring back! Now THAT'S a heroic comeback. Cue the cheesy music!
Flipped a {voteDiff}-vote hole! Fighting for what's right, with glitter. I'm weirdly proud!
Climbed back from {voteDiff} behind! Scrappy, sparkly, a bit rude. Perfect.
{momentTitle} just slipped into the lead with zero fuss. Stealthy! My favourite kind of hero.

messages: {username} voted {momentTitle} too! A squad! I was never a squad person, but sure!
{username} picked {momentTitle}. Matching stars! Don't make it weird. Make it a little weird.
{username} is on your side with {momentTitle}. Team up! I'm officially approving it. Kuro, stop growling.
{username} backed {momentTitle} as well. That's a Guardian pair! Sparkles for both of you!
Same pick as {username}! Twin stars. Mildly sickening. In the best way.
{username} agrees with you on {momentTitle}. That's rare enough to put on a poster!
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Two of you! A tiny team! The galaxy's safe. Slightly.
{username} has taste and it matches yours. Shiro approves. Shiro approves of everything.
details: A sidekick! I've always wanted one.
Don't tell them my guns like them.
Two stars. Brighter together. Barf. Aww.
Look at you, saving the world together!
I give it a week before one of you tries to be the hero.
Squad forming. Please pick a better name than mine.

messages: {username} picked {theirMoment} over {yourMoment}? A rival star! Okay, I'm getting my dramatic voice ready.
{username} voted against {yourMoment}. Aww. A villain! Finally, my kind of plot!
{username} chose {theirMoment}. Not mad. Kuro, stop sharpening things!
{username} went for {theirMoment}. New entry in the Guardian's Annoying List!
{username} is against you on {yourMoment}. Finally, some real story!
{username} thinks {theirMoment} is better. Brave! Possibly foolish. Definitely entertaining!
{username} voted against you. Rivals! Every good hero needs a rival. Pick up the glitter!
{username} versus you! I'm getting popcorn and a front-row seat for the dramatic bits.
details: I'm not saying fight. I'm saying be heroic.
The guns want a word. Politely. Then not politely.
They'll learn. Heroes always win. Usually.
A rival! Finally, the plot thickens!
I like them already. They give me something to be dramatic about.
I don't care. I care. I care a sparkly amount.
A little rivalry is good for the galaxy!

messages: Ten matches in a row with {username}! That's a proper Guardian pair! I take back my sarcasm. Mostly.
{username} has agreed with you ten times running. That's either destiny or a cult with glitter!
Ten straight with {username}! The stars aligned. Annoyingly neatly.
{streakCount} matches in a row with {username}! That's a legendary duo! Somebody write a song. Not me!
{streakCount} for you and {username}. Perfectly in sync, like twin stars. I'm sniffling. It's glitter.
{streakCount} straight with {username}! Hand them both a badge. A big shiny one.
details: I'm speechless, and I've got plenty of guns to talk to.
Is this healthy? The stars say yes.
That's not chance, that's a bond. Yuck. Aww.

messages: Ten matches against {username}! You two are the main storyline now!
{username} has disagreed with you ten times running. That's not a rival, that's an origin story!
Ten battles with {username}. I'm taking notes for the sequel.
details: This is the finale arc. Early.
A hero needs a rival. Congrats, you've got a good one.

messages: {streakCount} matches against {username}. Okay, this is a galactic feud. I'm so into it!
{streakCount} battles with {username}. Sort it out with glitter? Or fists? Yes!
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a whole saga.
details: Bigger than any star war. Almost!
I'm nervous and proud and a bit glittery.
One of you has to win eventually. Neither will.

messages: {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft} and you haven't voted. Duty calls! Don't make it a bad call.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Your vote's missing from the squad! Shiro's sulking about it.
{matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft}. It takes ten seconds. Even a reluctant hero can do ten seconds.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle} and no vote from you? A real Guardian would've voted already. Just saying.
Hero alert! {matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The sparkle's running low!
{timeLeft} until {matchTitle} closes and your vote's still backstage. Get out there, hero!
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}! This is your heroic moment! Don't blow it!
{timeLeft}! That's all the starlight left on {matchTitle}. Go go go!
Last call on {matchTitle}! {timeLeft} left. Guardians don't dawdle!
{matchCount} matches are about to close and none of them have your vote! First one ends in {timeLeft}!
{matchCount} unvoted matches, all counting down. The first one goes in {timeLeft}.
Zero votes on {matchTitle}! Not a single star in the sky. Somebody has to shine first!
Nobody's voted on {moment1} versus {moment2}. Silence. Even Kuro's quiet. That's worrying!
Brand new match and not a single vote. Be the first hero. Please? Pretty please?
{matchTitle} needs a first star. I know someone who's very, very available.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural} on this one. It's the loneliest corner of the galaxy!
Hardly anyone's voted here. A Guardian would help. I'm just pointing it out!
Low turnout. I blame all of you. Equally. With sparkles.
Barely any votes here. Somebody save this match!
details: It deserves more stars. So do I.
Don't be shy. Shine a little!

messages: {matchTitle} is dead level and one vote tips the balance. Funny, I know someone who hasn't voted. Guess who!
Perfect tie on {matchTitle}. Two stars, equal glow. I'm looking at you, hero. Hehe!
Dead even and nobody's moving. You haven't voted. You're the tiebreaker! Heroic, right?
{moment1} and {moment2}, locked together, and you've been quiet. Fix that!
{matchTitle} is still tied and the starlight's almost gone! Last chance to break it!
Dead level, almost no time left. You're the only hero who can fix this!
Still tied with the glow fading. Pick a side! Do it for the drama!
Round {round} is open! {matchCount} new matches. A new mission, Guardian!
{matchCount} fresh matches in round {round}. Plenty of sparkle. Plenty of trouble.
Round {round} just started! {matchCount} matches need a hero. Hurry hurry hurry!
New round! {matchCount} matches! Nobody's safe! Not even the glitter!
{momentTitle} just advanced! Mission accomplished. I'd say I knew all along. I did, actually.
{momentTitle} beat the competition. The next round's about to see stars. Literally.
{momentTitle} survived! I never doubted it. Okay, Kuro doubted. Rude little gun.
{momentTitle} is through! Somebody's a hero today. Hehe, you!
{momentTitle} moves up and the rest are space dust. Pretty space dust.
{momentTitle} won! Good call! Hero of the hour, you!
details: One down, lots of galaxy left.
The bracket just shrank. Tidier! Glitterier!

messages: {momentTitle} is out. Even heroes lose sometimes. I'm writing a very angry poem about it.
{momentTitle} lost. Everyone who voted against it has been added to the glitter-list. It's long.
Fine. {momentTitle} is gone. I'm not upset. I'm just sparkling with rage.
{momentTitle} was too bright for this universe anyway. Obviously.
{momentTitle} is out, and the stars dimmed a bit. I hate dim stars. Somebody make noise!
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Moving on! Not really. Okay, a little. A heroic little.
details: They'll pay for this. With interest. And glitter.
It was good. The whole galaxy knows.
You'll find another one. Stars always come back.
Every star burns out eventually. It's fine. It's fine!

messages: Still browsing? Pick one! Any one! Heroes decide fast. I'm lying, I take ages. Hurry anyway!
No pressure, but are you gonna vote or just stare at the stars?
They're all pretty! Pick one! Act first, glitter later!
Decisions, decisions. Close your eyes, point at the sky, and go.
details: Your opinion matters. A sparkly amount.
Don't overthink it. Overthinking dims the glow.
Trust your gut. It knows the way to the stars.

messages: New recruit! Welcome! {liveCount} matches live and every one of them needs a hero!
{liveCount} edits fighting it out and you just landed in the middle. Pick a side before one picks you!
Oooh, a newcomer! Sparkles are ready, guns are warm, and {liveCount} matches are live. You'll love it.
No rules, {liveCount} live matches, and a very glittery me. Welcome to the fun part!
Day two! You came back! I wasn't waiting by the door. I was waiting by the door.
Two days running! Look at you, a real Guardian!
Back again? Day two! I could get used to this. Don't tell Shiro.
{days} days! Where were you? I'm not asking because I care. I'm asking because Kuro misses you!
You're back after {days} days! The galaxy kept spinning. Mostly with explosions.
{days} days away. I noticed. The stars looked a bit dull without you.
Oh, you're back! Good. The stars were dull!
Look who's here! Ready for another mission?
You came back! Let's go save something. Or break it.
Your first vote! Feels like nothing. Then you feel a tiny star click on!
You picked a side! That's how every Guardian story begins.
Five already? You're sticking with the mission! Weird. Good weird!
Five votes! Okay, now I'm keeping an eye on you, hero.
details: Most recruits quit before this. +{xp} XP
Look at you, glowing steadily! +{xp} XP

messages: Ten! You're a regular Guardian now. Don't make it weird!
Ten votes! You keep reporting for duty. Kuro's started saving you a spot. Hehe.
details: Regulars get the brightest spot. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes! That's a whole constellation of opinions!
You're getting loud! The stars can hear you!
details: Twenty-five stars in the sky! +{xp} XP

messages: Fifty votes! You're properly deep in the mission!
Fifty! Most people never make it past the opening credits. Their loss!
details: You're past the first act. +{xp} XP

messages: A hundred votes! That's legend stuff, a whole-sky legend!
A hundred! I'd say I'm impressed, but Kuro already said it. Loudly.
Three days running! You came back! Hehe, Shiro kept your spot warm!
Three days! Something's lighting up.
details: Showing up again is the heroic bit. +{xp} XP

messages: A whole week! You really do keep showing up, hero!
Seven days! I stopped counting. Okay, I didn't. Kuro keeps a tally.
Two weeks! Nothing stops you, does it? Not even bad weather!
Fourteen days! Even stars flicker by day ten!
Thirty days! I don't know what to say. Thanks, Guardian!
A whole month! You stayed. That means more than my eye-roll admits!
Five underdogs! You back the stars nobody else is watching!
Backing the underdog star again! Respect. Mildly irritating respect.
Fifteen underdogs! You've got a thing for rebel stars!
Rebel! Yeah. I see it!
details: You don't follow the constellation, do you? +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty underdogs! You never pick the obvious star!
Thirty! You always pick the star nobody else was watching!
details: The constellation can't pin you down. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the scene! That's five matches now!
Early again! That's five first arrivals!
details: You love a quiet sky. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen matches where you shone first! Impressive!
Early, over and over! You never wait for the others!
Ten close ones! You like it on the knife edge, huh?
Another razor edge! Are your hands shaking? Mine are glittering!
Twenty-five close matches! You keep tipping the stars!
Your vote keeps landing exactly where it matters!
You backed the one that was behind. Five times! Stubborn! Heroic!
You never leave a star behind. I love that.
Same one, three times! You've got a favourite star!
That one again? Yeah. It shines.
details: You know your favourite star. +{xp} XP

messages: Five votes for one star! That's a proper oath!
Okay, you've sworn a Guardian oath to that one. No take-backs!
details: Loyal to the last star. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten times! That's not a favourite, that's a whole galaxy!
Ten votes, same moment. I'll keep it secret. Shiro won't. Shiro squeaks.
details: Obsessed! Even the First Star would be impressed! +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds in! You're following the whole mission!
You came back for round two! The sequel's usually better!
Four rounds! You're properly in orbit now!
Deep in the bracket! Hope you like deep space.
All the way to round six! You saw the last star go out!
Six rounds! You stayed for the final scene! Wow!
details: From the first star to here. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches! You're poking around every planet!
Ten different matches! Peeking into every corner of the galaxy, huh?
Twenty-five matches! You've charted every corner of the galaxy!
Twenty-five! You've visited every planet on the map!
Fifty matches! That's not browsing, that's a whole tour of duty!
Fifty matches! You know this galaxy better than I do!
Five in one sitting! Can't stop saving the day, can you?
Five matches back to back! Keep going, hero!
Ten in one go! Take a breath! Glitter break!
Ten matches in one mission! Your boots must be glittery!
Voting at this hour? Yeah. Me too. Heroes never sleep. Not on purpose!
Middle of the night! That's when the stars are brightest.
You told people! Thanks! Really! Brighter star-signal!
Five shares! You're a human flare gun! Good!
details: Thanks for spreading the light. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares! You're basically a recruiting officer!
Fifteen! You keep recruiting half the galaxy!
details: You keep spreading the glow. +{xp} XP

messages: You were here before it got loud! Founding member! Yours forever!
One of the first thousand stars! That counts, you know!
details: Nobody can dim that star. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank! Look at you! Ugh, I'm proud. Gross!
You went up a rank! Don't let it go to your head. Or do. I'm busy!
Achievement unlocked: {name}! Sparkle!
Another one: {name}! Shine!
{rank}! Look at all the shiny new gear!
Mastery up! Now we're getting to the glittery bit!
Ten underdogs! Now THAT'S a heroic mess!
Ten long shots! You're a menace to your own team. I love it!
Ten close ones with Cupcake! Fine, you're good. Take a star!
Ten tight finishes with her! Don't tell her I applauded!
A whole week with Cupcake? You must love proper discipline!
Seven days of steady aim! Dull! Impressive! Mostly dull!
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie! Hero move! Boom!
A deadlock and you took the shot! Hero stuff!
Oh, it's me, in the sparkly outfit? Great choice! Questionable choice! Great!
Star Guardian Jinx! Try to keep up. I'll try not to complain. Much.

upcoming: Not open yet! I'm practising my heroic pose. It's mostly pouting. Check back soon!
Shh! The next mission's about to start. Shiro's wiggling. Always a sign.
Locked for now. Doesn't stop me planning a glittery ambush.
prevote: Two edits, one vote. Choosing is the hero's burden. Yawn. Okay, I like it.
Watch both. Then follow the one that sparkles in your gut.
I won't tell anyone which one you picked. Probably. Kuro might.
Take your time, hero! Actually, don't. Dramatic tension is killing my guns.
Go on, nobody's judging. Okay, the stars are. A little.
Pick the one you'd replay at 2am under the covers. You know the one.
prevote-empty: Nobody's voted yet. Be the first star in the sky, I dare you!
Empty sky! Put a star in it with a vote.
Not a single star out! Lonely! Fix it!
closing-24h: Less than a day left and you're still stargazing. Pick something, hero!
The day's nearly over. Don't make me hum the heroic countdown. I will, off-key.
closing-3h: Hours left. HOURS. Heroes act before the clock runs out!
Tick, tick, twinkle. That's the last of your light.
closing-final: Last hour! Act now, glitter later!
Any second now. Seriously. Hero up!
voted-early: One of the first stars in the sky! Bold! I'm into it!
Hardly anybody's voted and you chose a side anyway. Respect, Guardian!
voted-ahead: Look at you, backing the shining favourite! Don't get comfy. Stars drift.
{pct}% with you! Good eye. I didn't say that. Pretend I said something else.
Your pick's ahead. The whole sky agrees with you for once. Strange!
{pick} is pulling away! Feels good? Hold on to that glow!
Ahead, for now. Skies shift. So do crowds.
voted-close: That's close! Annoyingly close! I can't look. I'm looking between my fingers!
A sliver apart. One more vote could flip it. Tell a friend. Tell a Guardian!
Neck and neck! Your pick needs you and everyone who owes you a favour.
{pct} to {otherPct}. Somebody's getting frazzled and it's me, from the suspense.
voted-tied: Dead even! Nobody wins, nobody loses, everybody sparkles in confusion!
A perfect tie. Honestly? Rude of the universe.
voted-behind: You're behind! No pouting. I'd pout, but you shouldn't.
{pick} is trailing? Underdog star! My favourite kind of star!
They're ahead. Doesn't make you wrong. Just early to the glow!
Behind by {diff} points. Tell the whole galaxy. Loudly. Make a scene!
Everyone's shining the other way. Cool! Be the odd star.
closed-won: Your pick won! Of course it did. You've got Guardian instincts.
A win! A sneaky little burst of starlight. I'll take it!
{pick} went through! You called the finale like a Guardian!
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Let it twinkle sadly for a minute, then go again!
Didn't make it. I've had worse missions. So have you. Next one!
{pick} is out. Sorry. For real. I'll put a tiny star on its grave.
closed-tied: A tie! Somebody had to blink first and nobody did. Ha!
closed-unvoted: Voting's over. You missed this mission! There's always another.
All done here. {winner} claimed the stars. Next time, say something!

first-vote: Your first mission! The scary one. Now you're a Guardian. Welcome!
That's your first. Feels tiny, right? Wait for the glow.
You're on the team now. Try not to make it weird!
streak: Again? You keep showing up! I'm not complaining. I'm noting it down.
{streak} days running! Okay, now I'm watching your star.
Back again! Heroes keep coming back. Stay!
underdog: Backing the one nobody's cheering for? Ooh. Real hero stuff.
Bold! Everybody else is facing the other way. I love that.
Underdog, huh? That's the hero's pick. The messy, brave one.
early: Early! You get to shape the whole mission before anyone else arrives. Don't waste it!
Hardly anyone's here yet. Your vote's carrying the whole squad.
First to arrive! I'm pretending I'm not impressed.
close: That vote just nudged the stars! Feel it? Everything's close right now.
Razor thin! One more vote and the whole sky flips.
Close finish! Your vote counts here. A shiny amount.
behind: {pick} is behind. So? Behind isn't beaten. Go recruit some Guardians!
Not winning yet. Good! Means there's still a mission.
Behind, but the story's not over. Not even near the end!
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't get comfy. Stars shift fast!
Winning, for now. Enjoy it. Quietly. Or with fireworks. I'm not the boss.
Look at that! Excellent pick. Obviously.
default: Logged, Guardian! I'm not changing your mind. Not yet.
Done! That vote's in the Guardian logbook now.
Your vote's in. Go see what other missions are out there!

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no mission picked yet! Start with whichever one itches.
Everything's open! Take your pick, hero. I'll pretend I'm not watching.
{unvoted} to go. No pressure. Okay, a sprinkle of pressure!
live-some: {voted} done, {unvoted} to go! Keep the mission going!
You're deep in it now! {unvoted} more matches waiting on you.
Good start! The rest won't save themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left! You could clear the whole mission board!
Almost there! {unvoted} more and you're free.
So close! Don't clock out before the finale!
live-one: One left! Just one! Finish it!
Last one! Don't leave it hanging in the stars!
One match between you and mission complete!
live-closing: Some of these end in {timeLeft}! {unvoted} still need a hero. Move it!
The clock's roaring now! {unvoted} waiting, {timeLeft} left on the mission.
Almost out of starlight! Pick, quick!
live-done: You've voted in everything! Mission complete! Go see the bracket!
Nothing left for you on this one. Come back when round two lights up!
All done! That's rare. Thanks, Guardian!
live-none: No matches running right now. New missions soon! Go look at the bracket.
Quiet. Too quiet. The galaxy's napping. Check back soon!
No matches open. The galaxy's snoozing and I'm bored already!
brackets-groups: Groups first! The top two from each go through. The rest get a pat on the head!
Every star begins in a group. Not every star leaves one.
Watch the tables. They shuffle quickly!
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts arrive soon! The top two from every group go to the next stage.
No knockout yet. The groups have to wrap up first!
Patience! The knockout assembles itself once the groups finish.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now! One loss and you're out of the galaxy!
Single elimination! No respawns. Okay, a few. In my game.
Every match counts more now. Pick wisely. Or don't, I'm not your guardian angel.
brackets-bracket: Round by round! One loss and your star goes dark!
Follow the bracket. It narrows every round!
Every line here is a match somebody voted on. Ooh, destiny.
brackets-complete: And that's the cup! The final star! Thanks for being here!
It's over! Good run! I'll miss it. A bit. Don't tell Shiro.
That's the champion! All of it, worth the glitter!
brackets-empty: No bracket yet! Nothing's been drawn. The stars are still aligning.
Empty sky! The draw hasn't happened. Soon!

invite: {a} or {b}? One vote, no take-backs. Be a hero on Arcane Moments!
Two edits are fighting! {a} versus {b}. Come and save the day.
{a} versus {b} and the galaxy can't decide. Be the tiebreaker!
voted: I backed {pick} over {other}. Come and prove me wrong, hero!
{pick} got my vote. {other} did not. Your turn, hero!
Chose {pick} over {other} on Arcane Moments. Go on, argue with a Guardian.
early: I got one of the first votes in on {pick} versus {other}! Be quick, the sky's dark.
Early vote for {pick} over {other}. Come make it a real mission!
Hardly anybody's voted on {pick} versus {other} yet. Be a hero!
tied: {pick} and {other} are dead level! One vote tips the stars. Guess whose!
Dead tie, {pick} versus {other}. I'm peeking between my fingers. Come break it!
{pick} and {other} are exactly even. Somebody be a hero!
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart! My guns are vibrating. Come vote!
{voteDiff} votes between {pick} and {other}. This is gonna be loud!
Razor thin: {pick} versus {other}, {voteDiff} apart. Every vote counts now!
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A flicker, not a fade! Come relight it!
Down {voteDiff} against {other}, but {pick} isn't beaten. Help me out!
{pick} is {voteDiff} votes short of {other}. Don't leave me to rescue it alone!
losing-bad: {pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}! Villains everywhere. Come even it up!
Down {voteDiff} on {other}. {pick} needs the whole team, fast!
{pick} is getting buried by {other}. Rescue squad, anyone? Bring glitter!
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but it's tight! Come help me hold it.
{pick} is ahead of {other}, {pct}% to the rest. Don't let the star dim!
{pct}% for {pick} against {other}. Close enough to chew a glove!
dominating: {pick} is at {pct}% against {other}! Come watch the glitter fly, or join in!
{pick} is flattening {other}, {pct}%! Join the winning side before it's over.
